description: List the skills this account can run: SketchXFlow's built-in library (design review, consistency, spacing audit, accessibility, Indian pricing, WhatsApp button, …) and the user's own saved or imported skills. Each has a slug, what it does, its kind (edit = changes the page, ask = answers only, check = free report with an optional fix) and the blanks it needs. Run one with sketchxflow_run_skill.
name: sketchxflow_list_skills
title: List skills
